title: Maximum Product Of Three Numbers
description:
Given an integer array nums, find three numbers whose product is maximum and return the maximum product.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3]
Output: 6
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4]
Output: 24
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: nums = [-1,-2,-3]
Output: -6
```

## Constraints

- 3 <= nums.length <= 10^4
- -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000
